articles.title: From Emperors to World Records: The Sweet Saga of Ice Cream
articles.summary: July is National Ice Cream Month, but the frozen treat's history stretches back to ancient China. Discover how a luxury for the elite became an American obsession, complete with a 3,010-pound scoop and a $6,696 dessert.

articles.title: Fan Treasure Hunts, Shakira's Tribute, and a Stadium Homecoming: This Week in Latin Music
articles.summary: Natanael Cano is offering a $57,195 prize in a Mexico City QR-code hunt for loyal fans. Shakira honored immigrant World Cup workers onstage, and Fuerza Regida sold out Dodger Stadium. Plus, Karol G's foundation expands its impact.

articles.title: Three Ingenious Ways to Repurpose Your Old Kindle: Spotify Remote, Smart Display, or Literary Clock
articles.summary: Your outdated Kindle can become a Spotify controller, a customizable smart display for weather and calendars, or a clock that displays a unique book quote for every minute. These hacks require some effort but unlock surprising potential.
